Its square proportions, location, entrance/circulation and exact B/SB assignment are schematic; the surface GIS outline is reused only as a diagrammatic plate.

R2: brick shader adds running-bond courses using axis-aware world-position projections; facade window and greenhouse glazing tuned to the August 2019 Street View palette.

R3: added eight low-profile roof service-unit proxies distributed over the broad flat roof using visual positions from the 2023 Indiana GIO orthophoto; exact equipment count, type, and position are not verified.

R3: added schematic B and SB basement floor plates and cold-room enclosure proxies. Purdue GIS records B=-12 and SB=-24, and the 2021 Agronomy report describes basement cold storage; unit semantics, extents, room count, dimensions, and locations remain unverified.

R4: removed all four inherited rooftop mechanical curb boxes because three extended outside the GIS roof outline; retained eight low-profile source-informed service-unit proxies entirely on the broad roof, with count and exact positions still illustrative.

R4: replaced five unsupported small basement cold-room boxes with one walk-in climate-controlled seed-storage room whose reported area is 1,163 sq ft (108.05 m²), based on Purdue Agronomy Facilities & Equipment. Its square plan proportions/position and modeled B-level assignment are schematic; the source confirms basement location only.

R4: added an internal shelving arrangement and open central aisle inside the walk-in seed room as a cutaway illustration; detailed circulation, door placement, equipment type/count and room orientation remain unverified.
R4: facade and greenhouse glazing darkened to a more reflective gray-green cue from qualitative 2019 Street View; optical parameters are visual estimates, not measured material properties.

R5: added one combined shallow dark-metal frame/transom mesh across 76 existing facade glazing panels. The frame detail is a generic architectural readability refinement, not measured from the qualitative Street View; no facade dimensions are asserted.
specific_evidence_boundary: The official PPDL map confirms nearby greenhouse facilities but does not verify an attached wing. The glazed growing bay is a schematic facade inset fully inside the selected GIS footprint; the unverified outside service apron was removed and all facade/site mesh bounds are contained within the GIS bbox. The August 2019 Street View is qualitative and perspective-distorted. It supports brick/glazing/material cues only. The 2021 report supports dryer/grinder counts, not their modeled room locations. Floor slabs are now clipped to the exact official GIS ring; the GIS CRS transformation remains an approximate campus-local conversion. The Indiana GIO 2023 orthophoto provides a current, orthorectified roof/perimeter and orientation cross-check; overlay agreement is visual and not survey control. The Google place coordinate is a POI, not a surveyed control. GIS level fields SB/B/F01-F04 and Extrution have undocumented units/semantics; model heights and floor datums remain estimates, including the unresolved 9-foot model versus 12-unit GIS interval difference. Basement rooms and rooftop unit layout are schematic proxies. R4 corrects the four inherited roof curb elements that protruded beyond the selected GIS roof ring. Purdue Agronomy Facilities & Equipment (page 30) supports 15 sample dryers, four soil grinding units and dust arresters, and a 1,163 sq ft climate-controlled walk-in seed-storage room in the basement. R4 represents that reported area, but uses schematic proportions, position and a tentative B-level assignment because neither sublevel nor plans are specified. A further 790 sq ft seed-storage installation began in fall 2008; current status/location are unclear and it is not modeled. R5 adds a combined, schematic dark-metal frame/transom detail over 76 existing glazing panels to improve facade depth/readability. Frame widths, divisions, and locations are not measured or source-confirmed.

uncertainties: Interior circulation and finishes are schematic cues, not measured architectural plans.
August 2019 Street View is historical, perspective-distorted, and only partially exposes the exterior; facade segment dimensions and camera bearing were not calibrated.

GIS horizontal footprint is a strong plan source; Indiana orthophoto overlay visually confirms the roof perimeter/orientation, but no surveyed control point has verified the local projection or master placement to a stated tolerance.
Google Maps POI coordinate is approximate and may mark the place/building centroid or entrance vicinity; it is not survey control.

GIS Extrution, Elevation, SB, B, and F01-F04 units/semantics are undocumented. The modeled 9-foot above-grade datums conflict with 12-unit GIS intervals; height and floor elevations remain unresolved estimates.
August 2019 Street View is historical, perspective-distorted, and only partially exposes the exterior. It supports qualitative material cues, not dimensions or all elevations.

The 2021 report is indexed at the cited Purdue URL but direct PDF retrieval returned 404 in this pass; a separately found legacy Appendix-D.pdf is a general Agronomy review document, not LSPS floor plans.

The 2023 Indiana orthophoto shows rooftop service equipment generally but not its exact count or type. Eight roof-unit proxies are illustrative; the four previously out-of-footprint inherited curb boxes were removed.

The accessible Purdue Background Information report supports the dryer/grinder quantities and a 1,163 sq ft basement walk-in climate room. Exact room dimensions, position, entrance, circulation and B/SB sublevel are not provided; those are schematic.
The same report notes an additional 790 sq ft long-term seed-storage installation began in fall 2008, but its present completion/status and location are unknown; it is omitted.

Purdue vertical GIS values remain ambiguous: modeled above-grade datums are about 9 ft apart while F01-F04 differ by 12 undocumented units; no facade elevation or floor section has resolved the discrepancy.
R5 window frame/transom details are generic visual cues; the available 2019 Street View does not resolve dimensions or exact divisions.
